q5_answer.question: Does the HF router support grammars (GBNF) or JSON mode only?
q5_answer.verdict: mixed: 1/5 probed models accepted response_format=json_schema and 3/5 accepted json_object. Keep JSON mode plus Pydantic plus one repair retry as the portable baseline and use json_schema opportunistically where the chosen provider serves it

coverage.note: observation_rate is the share of the matrix the models actually answered; completion_rate is the share whose answer also validated — the difference between them is the schema-validity finding, not missing data. A candidate observed on a handful of documents is a data point, not a verdict. Re-running the tool resumes: the response cache keeps every answer that already validated.

prompt_hygiene.note: invariant_7_identifier_leaks must be 0: those values are sentinel-masked before the page is serialised. The unclaimed list is personal data no validator owns, so nothing masks it and it crosses the network verbatim under the laptop profile.
